terminationReason: The source compiles, deterministic validation passes, CircuitTikZ is the primary mechanism with semantically correct symbols (L, R, generic, sV, rectangle+diagonal block), the series topology, arrow direction and +/- polarity are right, and no target element is missing. One more automatic iteration has clear, concrete room to improve.
